svg.title: Poincaré v1.1.0 · Figure 6 · The Bit Delivered Twice: Two Kinds And No Third
svg.text: FIGURE 6
THE BIT DELIVERED TWICE: TWO KINDS AND NO THIRD
POINCARÉ · FORM BY THEOREM, VALUE BY THE ACT · MASTER v1.1.0_CC · EVERY NAME CHECKED
STEP 10 · THE BIT DELIVERED TWICE, BY ITS TWO KINDS, AND NO THIRD
KIND 1 · THE FORMAL CARGO
The record's value carried to the host's frame. It arrives free, the
antecedent a theorem; it gives the Poincaré sentence in one step; and it is
exactly the sentence.

svg.text: KIND 2 · THE PHYSICAL WITNESS
A physical relaxation of every manifold of the host, faithful to the class,
every step off the seat priced at the Landauer floor, bringing every
manifold to rest on the seat. Its last field is the bit read in the register of
heat, carried as a field, never proved.

svg.text: The two kinds are one bit
The physical witness is a formal cargo, and the
cargo is exactly the sentence.

tspan.font-family: RowMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Two kinds and no third
Every witness of the sentence, in any vocabulary, is
a delivery of both kinds.

svg.text: The one refuter
One manifold of the host that is not the round
sphere, one fake sphere, refutes both kinds at once.

svg.text: THE 2002–03 OFFERING, TYPED · ONE INHABITANT OF THE FORMAL KIND, DOWNSTREAM OF THE BRIDGE
One inhabitant of the formal kind
A witnessed flow, faithful to the class with a
functional strictly decreasing off the seat, delivers
the formal cargo.

svg.text: Strictly inside the cargo
The cargo stands where the host's own classifying
flow admits no witness: the offering is never the
ground.

svg.text: It walks our way
Every witnessed flow delivers both kinds, and fails if
the bit fails: our way in its own vocabulary.
